verdict.rationale: Rippling's own product pages say users can ask Rippling AI questions in natural language and have it act. It surfaces answers and automates remediations for devices and compliance, and 'agents handle ordering, routing, retrieving, and retiring devices' when you tell it what you need. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of supported commands, scope and limits beyond marketing copy, and independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language commands execute actions reliably.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Ask Rippling about any device, threat, or compliance gap—and AI surfaces answers, automates remediations, and builds audit-ready reports.
Tell Rippling what you need and agents handle ordering, routing, retrieving, and retiring devices across every warehouse and employee worldwide.
Ask Rippling AI anything across all your data
